title: Hantavirus Outbreak on Cruise Ship Exposes Passengers to Deadly Disease
key_takeaways: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has confirmed that multiple passengers on the cruise ship have tested positive for hantavirus, a rare but potentially deadly disease that can cause respiratory failure.
Passengers who are experiencing any of these symptoms are urged to seek medical attention immediately.
As the situation continues to unfold, passengers and crew members who may have been exposed to the virus are being closely monitored and provided with medical care as needed.
